title: SELLING YOUR OWN KIT KEEPS WHAT YOU FOUND
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. Hazard pay, the XP for the haul, a haul contract and your best haul all count what you carry out less what you carried up. Selling kit you brought up to the Peddler took it out of the backpack but still counted it as carried up, so selling 1,520 of your own Medkits and Plates and then finding 1,500 of salvage counted as finding nothing: no hazard pay, no haul XP, a failed haul card. A sale of kit you carried up now takes it off what you carried up, the reverse of buying, and lifetime earnings still count it as gone.
now: Selling your own kit at the Peddler no longer wipes out the hazard pay and XP for the loot you found.
